title: MythoSemantic: An Interactive System for Discovering Semantic Parallels Across Mythological and Religious Traditions
abstract: arXiv:2610.28452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a tool for the comparative study of mythological and religious texts. Traditional manual analysis is highly labor-intensive and difficult to scale. To address this, we use neural language models to embed texts into a shared semantic space, so that users can find semantic parallels across cultural traditions in an interactive interface. Embedded fragments form distinct semantic structures whose coarse geometry aligns with well-documented historical relations between traditions. We quantify how much of that geometry is already explained by lexical overlap and by proper names. The current system is available at https://mythoscope.io, and the installable package is available at https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md.

translated_title: MythoSemantic：一个用于发现神话与宗教传统之间语义平行关系的交互式系统
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于神话与宗教文本比较研究的工具。传统的人工分析高度依赖人力且难以扩展。为解决这一问题，我们使用神经语言模型将文本嵌入到共享语义空间中，使用户能够在交互式界面中发现不同文化传统之间的语义平行关系。嵌入的文本片段形成了独特的语义结构，其粗略的几何形态与文献中充分记录的各传统之间的历史关系相一致。我们量化了这种几何结构中有多少已经可以通过词汇重叠和专有名词来解释。当前系统可在 https://mythoscope.io 访问，可安装的软件包可在 https://github.com/haafus/MythoSemantic/blob/main/RUN.md 获取。
tldr: 该论文提出MythoSemantic交互式系统，利用神经语言模型将神话与宗教文本嵌入共享语义空间，使用户能够跨文化传统发现语义平行关系，且嵌入结构形成的语义几何形态与传统间的历史关系相吻合。
